# Subway Seat for Dark Reader

Dark Reader takes a background and a text color for each of its dark and light schemes, plus a scrollbar and a selection color, so the file is just those. The keys are Dark Reader's own setting names.

[Dark Reader](https://darkreader.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/dark-reader/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Dark Reader › See all options › Colors:

```text
Paste the values from subway-seat.json: Background, Text, Scrollbar and Selection,
once with Dark mode on and once with Light mode on.
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Dark Reader › See all options › Colors:

```text
Paste the values from subway-seat-tunnel.json: Background, Text, Scrollbar and Selection,
once with Dark mode on and once with Light mode on.
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Dark Reader › See all options › Colors:

## Follow light and dark

In Dark Reader › Settings › Automation:

```text
Turn on “Use system color scheme”, then set the behavior to “Toggle dark/light”.
```

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
